description: This is a PHP template file for rendering the blog index and post pages in the Goteo application. It handles displaying a list of blog posts, individual post details, SEO meta tags, social sharing, pagination, and comments.

classes.name: Paginated
classes.description: A utility class for paginating lists of items, providing methods for setting layout and generating navigation links.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: A model class representing images, providing methods for getting image links with specific dimensions.

classes.name: Post
classes.description: A model class representing blog posts, with a static method for retrieving posts by ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a blog post object by its ID.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Returns a URL link to an image with specified dimensions and options.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a reusable view component or template.

methods.name: get('header/share.html.php')
methods.description: Includes a shared header component related to social sharing buttons.
